name: Blue Dart Express Ltd
title: Blue Dart Express Ltd - 526612 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Blue Dart Q4 FY26 PBT before exceptional fell about 17% on ~8% revenue growth, with tonnage up only 4.6% and margins under pressure; management gave no numeric FY27 guidance.

utilisation.quote: So it continues to be at around 85% on a pallet utilization level.

capex.quote: our capex for the year is almost INR 360 crores, whereas standalone, it is INR 120 crores.

triggers.label: Q4 PBT before exceptional down ~17%
triggers.quote: there is a drop of about 17% in the comparable PBT before exceptional items for the quarter

triggers.label: Price hikes absorbed by mix and cost
triggers.quote: it would be better than 3% to 4% is what I can say.

triggers.label: Surface shipment per kg slowing
triggers.quote: The shipment per kg for ground surface has ....I think, has come down as compared to earlier years

guidance.quote: Without really giving color of forward-looking statement
As soon as possible, that's what we'll track.

prior_guidance_check.quote: I think we are lagging that guidance by some distance.

red_flags.quote: I think we are lagging that guidance by some distance.
